instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Jupyter Data Science stack.
- Jupyter Lab with common DS packages
- Port 8888
output:
FROM jupyter/datascience-notebook:latest
WORKDIR /workspace
RUN mamba install -y pandas numpy scikit-learn matplotlib seaborn plotly && mamba clean -afy
EXPOSE 8888
CMD ["start-notebook.py", "--NotebookApp.token=''"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a PyTorch training environment.
- GPU support via nvidia base
- Port 6006 for tensorboard
output:
FROM nvidia/cuda:12.4.0-runtime-ubuntu22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
EXPOSE 6006
CMD ["tensorboard", "--logdir", "/workspace/logs", "--host", "0.0.0.0"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for an MLflow tracking server.
- Port 5000
- Uses SQLite backend
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir mlflow
WORKDIR /mlflow
EXPOSE 5000
CMD ["mlflow", "server", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "5000", "--backend-store-uri", "sqlite:///mlflow.db", "--default-artifact-root", "./mlruns"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Ray cluster head node.
- Port 8265 for dashboard, 6379 for GCS
output:
FROM rayproject/ray:2.11.0-py310
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8265 6379
CMD ["ray", "start", "--head", "--port=6379", "--dashboard-host=0.0.0.0", "--dashboard-port=8265"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a FastAPI model serving endpoint with a scikit-learn model.
- Loads model.pkl on startup
- Port 8000
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY model.pkl .
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a DVC (Data Version Control) environment.
- Includes dvc with s3 support
- Port 8080 for dvc studio if needed
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "dvc[s3]" dvc-data
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
RUN dvc init || true
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["bash"]
